summary: Read an m by n height matrix of non-negative integers. Both m and n are less than 150. The first ocean touches the left side and the top side. The second ocean touches the right side and the bottom side. Water may move only up, down, left, or right, and only into a cell whose height is equal or lower. Find every cell whose water can reach both oceans. Write those coordinates in any order.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
